name: @fhirpath-lab/fml-executor
description: Internal model-aware FML execution and conformance tests

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=cjs --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/testing/corpus.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/testing.js
scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild src/test/FmlExecutor.test.ts src/test/FmlErrors.test.ts src/test/FmlCoverage.test.ts src/test/FmlTracing.test.ts src/test/FmlPerformance.test.ts src/test/FmlCorpus.test.ts src/test/FmlXverComparison.test.ts src/test/FmlXverWarnings.test.ts src/test/FhirTerminologyService.test.ts src/test/FmlModelIdentity.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --external:esbuild --outdir=dist/test && node --test dist/test/FmlExecutor.test.js dist/test/FmlErrors.test.js dist/test/FmlCoverage.test.js dist/test/FmlTracing.test.js dist/test/FmlPerformance.test.js dist/test/FmlCorpus.test.js dist/test/FmlXverComparison.test.js dist/test/FmlXverWarnings.test.js dist/test/FhirTerminologyService.test.js dist/test/FmlModelIdentity.test.js
scripts.test:corpus: npm run build && esbuild src/test/ExternalCorpus.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --outfile=dist/test/ExternalCorpus.test.js && node --test dist/test/ExternalCorpus.test.js
scripts.test:xver: npm run build && esbuild src/test/ExternalXverComparison.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --outfile=dist/test/ExternalXverComparison.test.js && node --test dist/test/ExternalXverComparison.test.js
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && esbuild src/testing/benchmark.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --outfile=dist/benchmark.js && node --expose-gc dist/benchmark.js
scripts.benchmark:xver: npm run build && esbuild src/testing/xver-benchmark.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@fhirpath-lab/validator --outfile=dist/xver-benchmark.js && node --expose-gc dist/xver-benchmark.js
